title: Stir-Fry with Cashew and Norweigan Salmon
description: A delicate and flavorful Chinese dish made with stir-fried vegetables and crispy cashews, topped with pan-seared Norwegian salmon.
instructions: 1. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, and 2 tablespoons of water. Set aside.
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
3. Add the salmon fillet and sear for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Transfer the salmon to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
5. In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
6. Add the broccoli and carrots and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
7. Add the chopped cashews and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
8. Stir in the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
9. Return the salmon to the skillet and spoon some of the vegetable mixture over the top.
10. Serve immediately and garnish with chopped scallions if desired.
